newsitem.title: USA: Premier chooses Agfa Medical as supplier.
newsitem.headline: Premier chooses Agfa Medical as supplier.

text.p: Agfa Medical and Premier Inc said on Monday that Agfa Medical will be the sole-source supplier of cine film, chemistry, and related needs to Premier Inc, a health care alliance of 700 hospitals and health care facilities.
Group purchasing of supplies, pharmaceuticals, and equipment is one of the major programs Premier operates to hold down costs at its member hospitals, the companies said in a joint statement.
Agfa is a unit of Bayer AG.
The value of this deal was not immediately available.
